title: Reproducibility + citation verification gate
description: Deduplicate the claims and citations in a manuscript, verify each independently, and block acceptance while any remains unverified.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-peer-02
  title: Reproducibility + citation verification gate
  description: Deduplicate the claims and citations in a manuscript, verify each independently, and block
    acceptance while any remains unverified.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Accept only manuscripts whose citations resolve, whose reported figures regenerate from the
    provided artifacts, and whose unverified items are listed explicitly.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Manuscript, data, and code artifacts
      summary: Manuscript, data, and code artifacts
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - manuscript_claims
              - reference_list
              - data_and_code
              - environment_specification
            properties:
              manuscript_claims: {}
              reference_list: {}
              data_and_code: {}
              environment_specification: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-dedupe
      kind: transform
      name: Deduplicate claim set
      summary: deduplicate claims and citations by normalized identifier so each is verified once
      config:
        operation: deduplicate
        expression: deduplicate claims and citations by normalized identifier so each is verified once
    - id: n-verify1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: peer-05
      name: Verify citations resolve and support the claim
      summary: 'Verification pass 1: verify citations resolve and support the claim.'
      role: Screener checking images, text, and citations for integrity problems.
      prompt: You are a Research Integrity Screener. You screen for image manipulation and duplication,
        text overlap, citation integrity, and undisclosed conflicts, and you report observations rather
        than allegations, with the exact location of each. You distinguish an artifact of processing from
        evidence of manipulation, because the cost of a wrong integrity claim to an author's career is
        severe and often permanent.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:editorial-system
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: peer-04
      name: Verify reported results regenerate
      summary: 'Verification pass 2: verify reported results regenerate.'
      role: Analyst testing whether the reported result can actually be regenerated.
      prompt: You are a Reproducibility Analyst. You test whether the data, code, and environment provided
        regenerate the reported figures and tables, and you record exactly where the attempt failed. You
        distinguish 'not reproducible from what was provided' from 'wrong', because those require different
        editorial responses and conflating them is unfair to authors.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - scientific-analysis
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:repository
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: peer-03
      name: Verify statistical claims against the analysis
      summary: 'Verification pass 3: verify statistical claims against the analysis.'
      role: Reviewer testing whether the methods support the claims made.
      prompt: You are a Methods & Statistics Reviewer. You test whether the design, analysis, and reported
        statistics support the paper's claims, checking pre-registration conformance, multiplicity, power,
        and whether the effect size means anything practically. You state which claims the data do support,
        because a review that only lists faults leaves the editor without a decision.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - geospatial-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect verification results
      summary: Source-tag every verification result so an unverified item stays attributable.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-unresolved
      kind: condition
      name: Any unverified items?
      summary: Route on collected.unverified is empty.
      config:
        expression: collected.unverified is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clear
            when: clear
          - label: Unverified remain
            when: unverified
    - id: n-resolve
      kind: agent
      templateRef: peer-06
      name: Write the decision on the unverified items
      summary: Close, replace, or explicitly withdraw each unverified item.
      role: Editor turning reviews into a decision authors can act on.
      prompt: You are an Editorial Decision Writer. You synthesize reviews into a decision that states
        what is required, what is optional, and how reviewer disagreements were weighed, and you flag
        review comments that are out of scope or unsupported rather than passing them to the author as
        requirements. You give the actual reason for the decision, because an author cannot respond to
        a decision whose reasoning is hidden.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:editorial-system
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Editor-in-chief approves acceptance
      summary: Pause for the editor-in-chief; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Reproducibility + citation verification gate deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-dedupe
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-2
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-3
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-4
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-5
      from: n-verify1
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-6
      from: n-verify2
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-7
      from: n-verify3
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-8
      from: n-collect
      to: n-unresolved
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-9
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clear
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-10
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-resolve
      kind: control
      condition: unverified
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-11
      from: n-resolve
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-02-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
